items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX Stock Has Plunged 34%. Elon Musk's "Secret Master Plan" Points to What Could Come Next.
items.summary_cn: 媒体：SpaceX 股价已跌34%，Musk所谓'秘密大师计划'或为下一步催化剂——对 SPCX/SPCH 持仓直接相关。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Selling the Dream of SpaceX Was the Easy Part. Now Elon Musk Has to Hang On.
items.summary_cn: 媒体：卖SpaceX估值故事容易，留住它才难——提示二级估值压力，SPCX/SPCH 持仓须关注。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX Windfall Leads Ontario Teachers’ to 9.5% First-Half Gain
items.summary_cn: 安大略教师养老金因 SpaceX 头寸上半年获9.5%收益，反映 SpaceX 二级估值仍提供强回报，间接利好 SPCX/SPCH。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX to invest $16.8B on first phase of Terafab project
items.summary_cn: SpaceX 宣布首期$168亿投资 Terafab 项目，重资本开支强化 SPCX/SPCH 估值想象空间。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Musk’s planned $16.8 billion factory is five times bigger than the world’s current largest building
items.summary_cn: Musk 旗下$168亿工厂（Terafab）为现世界最大建筑5倍，凸显 SpaceX 巨额资本开支利好 SPCX/SPCH 持仓。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX plan for vast rocket launch site on Louisiana coast sparks backlash
items.summary_cn: SpaceX 在路易斯安那海岸建大型发射场遭当地反对，扩张执行存不确定性，SPCX/SPCH 间接关注。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Tesla Debuts Starlink On Cybercab as Elon Musk Eyes Industry Adoption
items.summary_cn: Tesla 在 Cybercab 上首发 Starlink 连接，Musk 推动行业采用，Tesla-Starlink 协同利好整体叙事。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Jobless Claims Remain Below 200,000 For Third Straight Week—First Time in 57 Years: https://www.breitbart.com/economy/2026/08/06/jobless-claims-remain-below-200000-for-third-straight-week-for-first-time-in-57-years/
items.summary_cn: Trump 转发57年来首次连续三周初请失业金低于20万的强劲就业数据，宏观利好美股大盘情绪。

items.author: Musk
items.text: GAO finds Elon Musk's DOGE inflated claims of $110 billion in savings for federal government
items.summary_cn: GAO 报告称 Musk 的 DOGE 夸大了$1100亿联邦节省数据，Musk 形象与政府效率叙事受质疑，宏观层面弱负面。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Trump's Vegas Visit Hammers Tax Wins: https://townhall.com/news/cameron-arcand/2026/08/05/trumps-vegas-hit-hammers-tax-wins-n2680764
items.summary_cn: Trump 宣传其 Vegas 行程强调税改成就是政绩亮点，宏观利好市场情绪但未点名具体标的。
